proposals.title: FIRST STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Scott M. Stringer, Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Employees' Retirement System and the New York City Teachers' Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of EEO-1 workforce data by race and gender on website or corporate responsibility report, and encourages release of workforce pay data by race and gender.
proposals.evidence: Board of Directors' Recommendation Against and Statement of Opposition to the First Stockholder Proposal

proposals.title: SECOND STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing company policies, payments used for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, and board and management oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: Board of Directors' Recommendation Against and Statement of Opposition to the Second Stockholder Proposal
